security.hero_description: Your safety and peace of mind are important to us. Discover good practices for meeting people online safely.

intro.title: ❤️ Take care of yourself
intro.description: Online dating can help create beautiful relationships. However, always take the time to get to know someone before trusting them. If a situation seems strange or makes you uncomfortable, trust your instincts.

money.title: Never give money
money.description: This is one of the most important rules on dating platforms.
money.item1: Never send money to someone you met online.
money.item2: Even if their story seems urgent or emotional.
money.item3: Do not participate in an investment proposed by someone you met on the platform.

money_requests.title: Beware of money requests
money_requests.description: Be especially careful with requests involving situations presented as urgent.

personal.title: Protect your personal information
personal.description: Do not share information too quickly that could allow someone to identify or locate you.

time.title: Take your time
time.description: A sincere relationship is built gradually. Never feel pressured to do something too quickly.
time.item1: Gradually get to know the person.
time.item2: Ask questions and observe their answers.
time.item3: Do not let anyone pressure you.

suspicious.title: Watch for suspicious behavior
suspicious.description: Some behaviors may be signs that a person is not being honest with you.

meeting.title: For a first meeting
meeting.description: If you decide to meet someone in person, take a few simple precautions.
meeting.item3: Keep your own means of transportation if possible.

report.title: Does something seem suspicious?
report.description: If someone asks you for money, threatens you, harasses you, or behaves in a way that makes you uncomfortable, do not stay silent. Use the reporting tools available on Christian Alliance.

security.footer: 🛡️ Your safety matters to Christian Alliance
